highlights.title: Apps and AI accounts on one page
highlights.text: Connections, Tools and Accounts are now Apps & accounts. Connect an app in 3 steps: open Composio, paste your link, pick the bots that may use it.

highlights.title: A monthly budget for each bot
highlights.text: Set a token or dollar limit in a bot's settings under Usage. At 80% you get a heads-up; at 100% the bot pauses until you raise the limit or continue this month.

highlights.title: One line when a connection stops working
highlights.text: When a bot's app or server fails, its chat says which one and why, with Reconnect when only you can fix it. The line says when it works again.

highlights.title: The team browser recovers when it's busy
highlights.text: Idle pages pause and free memory. When the browser is busy, kwant tries again for up to 45 seconds and tells the bot to retry, instead of a Docker error.

fixes: Dev mode has no daily cap of 30 model calls. Cards the old cap stopped are written again.
Fix it and line notes on a PR a person wrote go to the lead of the team that owns the repo.
A bot that needs you to connect an app posts a card instead of a sign-in link.
